gate_semantics.PROJECT: allow when (a) a project_members row exists for (member, slug, project_id, role IN allowed, is_active) OR (b) ANY active project_members row for (member, slug, project_id) AND an active workspace_members row for (member, slug, role=ADMIN) - the workspace-admin bypass requires project membership (:52-78). Two to three EXISTS queries.
gate_semantics.WORKSPACE: allow when a workspace_members row exists for (member, slug, role IN allowed, is_active) - single EXISTS query (:44-51)
